name: Belmont Hill Sport Camps
description_short: Weeklong full-day sport camps (9:00 am–4:00 pm) for boys and girls ages 6–15, run by Belmont Hill School, with coed and single-sex camps in baseball, basketball, flag football, lacrosse, multi-sports, soccer, and strength & conditioning. Campers bring their own lunch.
refund_policy_summary: Each week or session requires a $100 nonrefundable deposit, credited toward fees. After May 18, 2026, no refunds for enrollment changes, withdrawal, or failure to attend. Students withdrawn for insufficient English get no refund.
